propositions: Root disk fills to 92-96% during autodeploy build burst and stays pinned because prune_docker_caches() only runs on deploy/backoff paths, not on quiescent-main no-op ticks every ~2 minutes
The no-op early exit at autodeploy.sh:228 returns without pruning between deploys, leaving no mechanism to reclaim disk when main is quiescent

prune_docker_caches() is defined at line 245 after the line-228 no-op exit call site, making it uncallable from that location; it must be relocated to the helper block at ~150 to precede all call sites

A pressure-triggered throttled reclaim on the no-op path fires every ~2 min exactly when no deploy is active and already holds the single-flight flock, reusing the root-disk-% computation from observability.sh:79
When root disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) and throttle window has elapsed, prune_docker_caches runs; below threshold or within throttle interval, no prune runs
Prune failure on the pressure path logs but does not alter autodeploy exit code (stays 0) and emits AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker to stderr
